newsitem.title: GERMANY: BOXING-FORMER CHAMPION ROCCHIGIANI TESTS POSITIVE.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-FORMER CHAMPION ROCCHIGIANI TESTS POSITIVE.

text.p: German Graciano Rocchigiani was caught cheating with drugs when he lost to compatriot Dariusz Michalczewski in a World Boxing Organisation (WBO) light-heavyweight title fight last August, German anti-doping sources said on Tuesday.

Traces of the banned stimulant ephedrine were found in Rocchigiani's urine after the fight in Hamburg, they said. Officials at Cologne's respected drug-testing laboratory were due to announce the test at a news conference later on Tuesday.
Rocchigiani, 33, was disqualified in the seventh round of the bout on August 10. He was adjudged to have thrown a punch after the pair had been told to break.
The anti-doping sources said Cologne laboratory's chief Wilhelm Schaenzer was due to confirm the test at a news conference starting at 1000 GMT.
